title: Caching and Streaming
summary: This module provides core functionalities for caching results of operations like language model calls and embedding computations, alongside robust streaming capabilities for DSPy programs. It enables incremental output delivery, status updates, and flexible output formatting for various use cases.

nodes.label: Global Cache Storage
nodes.title: DSPy Cache System
nodes.description: The central cache system used by DSPy to store and retrieve results of expensive operations, such as LM calls and embedding computations.

nodes.label: Function/Method to Cache
nodes.title: Target Function/Method
nodes.description: Any synchronous or asynchronous function or method whose execution results are intended to be cached to improve performance.

nodes.label: Language Model Service
nodes.title: External LM Provider
nodes.description: An external Language Model service (e.g., via LiteLLM) that provides responses, potentially in a streaming format.

nodes.label: DSPy Program Module
nodes.title: DSPy Program
nodes.description: A DSPy program or module instance that defines a sequence of operations, often involving language model calls.

nodes.label: Asynchronous Runtime
nodes.title: Python Asyncio
nodes.description: Python's built-in asynchronous event loop and concurrency utilities, used for managing async operations.

nodes.label: JSON Serialization/Parsing
nodes.title: JSON Utilities
nodes.description: Libraries like `orjson` and `jiter` used for efficient JSON serialization, deserialization, and partial parsing.

nodes.label: Adapter Configuration
nodes.title: DSPy Adapter Settings
nodes.description: DSPy's adapter settings (e.g., ChatAdapter, JSONAdapter, XMLAdapter) that dictate how LM outputs are structured and parsed.

nodes.label: File System
nodes.title: Local Storage
nodes.description: The underlying file system used for reading and writing serialized data, particularly for disk-based caching.

nodes.label: Synchronous Cache Wrapper
nodes.title: dspy.clients.cache.sync_wrapper
nodes.description: A decorator or wrapper that adds synchronous caching logic to a function. It checks the cache before execution and stores results if not found.

nodes.label: Asynchronous Cache Wrapper
nodes.title: dspy.clients.cache.async_wrapper
nodes.description: A decorator or wrapper that adds asynchronous caching logic to an async function. It checks the cache before execution and stores results if not found.

nodes.label: Secure Disk Serialization
nodes.title: dspy.clients.disk_serialization._RestrictedDisk
nodes.description: A specialized disk serialization class that enforces an allowlist for pickle deserialization, enhancing security when loading cached data from disk.

nodes.label: Cached Synchronous Embeddings
nodes.title: dspy.clients.embedding._cached_compute_embeddings
nodes.description: A synchronous utility that computes embeddings, automatically leveraging the DSPy cache to avoid redundant computations.

nodes.label: Cached Asynchronous Embeddings
nodes.title: dspy.clients.embedding._cached_acompute_embeddings
nodes.description: An asynchronous utility that computes embeddings, automatically leveraging the DSPy cache for efficient, non-blocking operations.

nodes.label: Execute in New Async Loop
nodes.title: dspy.streaming.messages.run_in_new_loop
nodes.description: A utility function designed to run an asynchronous function within its own dedicated asyncio event loop, isolating its execution.

nodes.label: Stream DSPy Program Output
nodes.title: dspy.streaming.streamify.streamify
nodes.description: The primary function that wraps a DSPy program to enable incremental streaming of its outputs, status messages, and allows for specific field listening.

nodes.label: Synchronous Stream Adapter
nodes.title: dspy.streaming.streamify.sync_streamer
nodes.description: A component that converts an asynchronous streaming generator, typically produced by `streamify`, into a synchronous generator for easier consumption in sync contexts.

nodes.label: Format for OpenAI Streaming API
nodes.title: dspy.streaming.streamify.streaming_response
nodes.description: Converts a DSPy program's output stream into a format compatible with the OpenAI streaming API, suitable for serving via web APIs.

nodes.label: Extract Specific Stream Fields
nodes.title: dspy.streaming.streaming_listener.StreamListener
nodes.description: A listener class that monitors an output stream to identify and extract specific fields from a predictor's response, adapting to different output formats (e.g., Chat, JSON, XML).

groups.label: Caching Mechanisms
groups.title: Core Caching Components
groups.description: Components responsible for implementing and managing caching strategies for both synchronous and asynchronous operations, including disk serialization.

groups.label: Streaming Core Logic
groups.title: Program Streaming Orchestration
groups.description: Components that enable and manage the incremental streaming of DSPy program outputs, including asynchronous execution and synchronous conversion.

groups.label: Streaming Output Handling
groups.title: Stream Formatting and Extraction
groups.description: Components focused on processing and formatting streaming outputs, such as converting to OpenAI API format or extracting specific fields.
